Pantry and expiry dates

Everything in your fridge, freezer and cupboards, by place, with its quantity and the date printed on the pack. "Use by" (safety) and "best before" (quality) dates are handled differently: a passed use-by date says do not eat, a passed best-before date says check it first. Opening dates and the delay printed on the pack, thawed food to finish within 3 days, a daily list of what to eat first, eaten or thrown away tracked with the reason and cost, and a shopping list fed by finished products. No barcode scanning, no product database: the pack and the food's condition always come first.
